summary:
Main
Iron ore futures and spot prices extended modest gains today with slight divergence across products. DCE most-tradedclosed at 648.0 yuan/mt, up 0.31% from the previous close. Seven Qingdao spot products including PB Fines and Carajas Fines rose 1 yuan/wmt while PB Lump slipped 2 yuan/wmt; seaborne 61% and 65% indices rose to USD 89.10 and 105.00/dmt with all 12 seaborne brands higher, whereas the port 58% index fell 3 yuan to 594 yuan/wmt.
